purpose: Runtime atlas containing 72 deterministic player-facing frames at five-degree intervals for aiming.
camera: screen-plane rotation of the approved top-down three-quarter master
facing: frame 0 faces right; 72 clockwise frames cover 0 through 355 degrees in five-degree steps
lighting: inherited unchanged from the approved player_base production master
prompt: Deterministic derivative with no new generative prompt: crop the approved transparent player_base master, normalize its visible diagonal to 60 pixels, center it in a 64x64 cell, and rotate clockwise from the unchanged base at exact five-degree intervals. Pack frames in row-major order into a 9x8 atlas.
negative_constraints: no identity, palette, material, lighting, or silhouette drift
no collision or gameplay value changes
